meta.title: Veronika Belousova — Custom digital workspaces for growing businesses
meta.description: I design and build custom digital workspaces for small and growing businesses — bringing clients, teams, documents, workflows and AI together in one place.

hero.title: Your business doesn't need another app. It needs a system that actually fits.
hero.tagline: I design and build custom digital workspaces for small and growing businesses — bringing clients, teams, documents, workflows and AI together in one place.
hero.support: Built around how your business works. Not the other way around.

problem.label: The problem
problem.heading: Scattered tools slow teams down
problem.intro: Most growing businesses don't lack software. They lack a connected place where work actually happens.

items.title: Tools everywhere
items.detail: Clients live in one app, documents in another, tasks in a third — and nobody has the full picture.

items.title: Duplicated work
items.detail: The same details get retyped between forms, chats, and spreadsheets. Time disappears into busywork.

items.title: Missing context
items.detail: When information is split, decisions slow down and handoffs break. People chase updates instead of serving customers.

items.title: Manual processes
items.detail: Approvals, reminders, and routine checks stay human-only — even when they could be guided or automated carefully.

capabilities.label: What I can build
capabilities.heading: A workspace shaped around your operations
capabilities.intro: These are options we can combine for your company — not a fixed package you have to buy as one product.

items.title: Custom digital office
items.detail: A shared home for your business: the screens, roles, and flows your team actually uses every day.

items.title: Client records & portals
items.detail: Keep client information organised, and open a clear client-facing space when your process needs one.

items.title: Document workflows
items.detail: Store, review, and move documents through the steps your business already follows.

items.title: Task management
items.detail: Assign work, track progress, and keep ownership visible across the team.

items.title: Communication & meetings
items.detail: Bring team chat and video meetings into the same environment when that reduces context switching.

items.title: Practical AI assistants
items.detail: Use AI where it helps — drafting, sorting, summarising, or supporting document review — without turning your business into an experiment.

items.title: Integrations & automation
items.detail: Connect tools you already rely on and automate the repetitive steps that eat into your week.

whyCustom.label: Why custom
whyCustom.heading: Tailored to your process — not a shelf of features
whyCustom.intro: Off-the-shelf software is often the right choice. Custom work makes sense when your process is the product — and existing tools force awkward workarounds.

items.title: Built around real workflows
items.detail: We start from how your team already works, then design the system to support that flow.

items.title: Modular by design
items.detail: Add only what you need now. Expand later when the next process is ready.

items.title: Incremental rollout
items.detail: Ship in stages so your team can adopt changes without freezing day-to-day operations.

items.title: Works with what you have
items.detail: When it is practical, we integrate existing systems instead of forcing a full replacement.

caseStudy.label: Featured case study
caseStudy.heading: SPIORA — a custom workspace for an immigration business
caseStudy.context: Immigration work depends on accurate client records, careful document handling, and clear coordination across the team. Spreadsheets and disconnected tools make that harder as volume grows.
caseStudy.solution: SPIORA is a custom digital workspace designed around that operating model — one place for client work, team coordination, and practical AI support. It is not a one-size-fits-all SaaS product; the shape of the platform follows the business process.

process.label: How we work
process.heading: A clear path from conversation to launch
process.intro: You always know what happens next — and what we are validating before we invest in the next stage.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.detail: We map how your business works today: people, tools, bottlenecks, and the outcomes that matter.

steps.title: Scope & prototype
steps.detail: We define a focused first version and shape key screens so the direction is concrete before full build.

steps.title: Build & validate
steps.detail: We implement in stages, test with real workflows, and adjust based on what the team actually needs.

steps.title: Launch
steps.detail: We go live carefully — with access, roles, and handoff that your team can operate.

steps.title: Improve
steps.detail: After launch we refine based on usage: fix friction, add the next module, and keep the system useful.

about.label: About
about.heading: I listen to how businesses work — then build the system around it
paragraphs: My background is in journalism. That training is still the foundation of how I work: ask precise questions, listen carefully, and find the real process behind the request.
I moved into product and engineering because growing teams need more than another disconnected tool. They need a digital workspace that matches how people actually collaborate.
Today I design and build custom platforms for small and growing businesses — combining product thinking, practical AI, and careful delivery so the result feels clear, human, and usable.

items.a: Roles, screens, workflows, client-facing areas, document steps, automations, and how AI is used — scoped to what your business needs now.

items.q: Can you connect tools we already use?
items.a: Often yes, when those tools offer a stable way to connect. We evaluate feasibility early so expectations stay realistic.

items.q: How big is a typical project?
items.a: Most engagements start with a focused first version — enough to improve a real process — then grow module by module. Timeline depends on scope and readiness of your materials.

items.q: Do you maintain the system after launch?
items.a: Yes. We can agree on support for fixes, improvements, and the next modules so the workspace keeps matching your operations.
Access is role-based. Sensitive environments can use stronger authentication options. We avoid exposing private customer data in demos or marketing materials.
Your team uses the system in real work. We review friction, prioritise improvements, and plan the next useful addition — without bloating the product.
